cap_lift_note: Owner ruling 2026-10-14: the lift is capped at 1.0 — nobody rises for survival; the charge on thin-evidence players stands and the lens totals fall by it. Measured: MEASURED_TABLES_F1.txt.
design: [1, min(age,24)-24, (age-24)+, (age-29)+, (age-33)+, band0, band0 x (tenure>=2), band6-20, band21-50, band51-100, band101+]

design_notes.age: the engine's integer age at the base season: max(Y - birth_year, 18 + (Y - cycle_year)) (rl_model._age_at); at application the board row's age(p) at AGE_REF = 2026
design_notes.application: RELATIVE within a cohort, CAPPED: vP_k' = round(vP_k x min(1, S_k / Sbar_k(cohort))) over the CHARGED rows (games >= 1); Sbar_k(cohort) = sum(vP_k x S_k) / sum(vP_k) over the charged rows of the cohort. Cohorts: one per integer age, ages >= 33 pooled into one, and any age with fewer than 5 charged rows joins the nearest larger cohort below it. The cap means the lens totals can only fall: NOT sum-preserving.
design_notes.bands: career-games bands; the reference band is 1-5 games; dummies for 0 games (with a 2nd+-season tenure term), 6-20, 21-50, 51-100, 101+
design_notes.games: career games through the base season (fit: cumulative scoring games <= Y; application: the board row's games)
design_notes.monotone_in_evidence: played bands: S(age,g) = min over band midpoints m >= g of S_raw(age,m), together with S_raw(age,g); for g > 180, S_raw(age,g). The 0-game band is NOT clamped under the 1-5 band: a first-year never-played rookie measures ABOVE it (fact-only window Y=2024: 0g tenure-1 raw S1 0.93 vs 1-5 band 0.80).
design_notes.zero_games: the 0-game band is fitted on the SAME outcome (never-played listed rows; tenure = seasons on a list through Y, 1 vs 2+; the fit supports the term: z = -11.0 / -3.8). It replaces the ever0 intake table. At application a 0-game row reports S but is EXCLUDED from the charge and from Sbar (m = 1): its vP is a pick-curve expectation that already averages over busts.

fit.model: additive-logit per lens (IRLS, ridge 1e-6); S1 = P(listed at the end of Y+1), S2 = P(listed at the end of Y+2)
fit.proxy_note: lastplay rows under-state listing by one season in 33 of 170 and by two in 9 of 170 retirees that carry both a list fact and games (measured on the store); tenure338 rows assume the #338 minimum tenure. The fit with and without the proxy rows: docs/evidence/engine_survival_hazard_2026-10-14/MEASURED_TABLES_F1.txt.

outcome: S_k(age, evidence) = P(on an AFL list at the END of season Y+k | listed at the END of base season Y, age at Y, career games through Y), k in {1,2}. last_listed_year per store row = _last_listed (a list fact, the AFL 2024/2025 list changes) when present; else 2026 for a row active today (the live board); else the last season with a game (a PROXY that under-states listing by one season for a retiree who sat out his last listed season); else, for a never-played retiree with no list fact, the #338 minimum tenure debut+N-1 (a PROXY). Listed at the end of Y iff debut <= Y <= last_listed_year (debut = draft year + 1; MSD = the draft year). outcome_k = 1 iff last_listed_year >= Y+k. Base seasons 2010..2024 (k=1) and 2010..2023 (k=2): the latest outcome year is 2025, covered by the couriered list changes; nothing depends on an unobserved future.
ruling_text: D-H = H2: retirement/exit risk on the +1 and +2 lens values is probability-based survival, spread across each age cohort by risk; the lift is capped at 1.0 (owner ruling 2026-10-14), so the lens totals fall by the within-cohort thin-evidence charge.
